title: Review lens: contact and props (D006)
summary: Applies the owner's 32 contact and props questions to a brief, storyboard or exact final encode and returns ranked, evidence-backed findings plus what was not checked.
description: This is the owner's authoritative adversarial review bank: the 1,024 questions of Appendix E of the Animation and Video Production Master Guide (10 Oct 2026), transcribed with the owner's exact text, ids, filters and pass membership. Another builder in this catalogue (harness_kit) independently wrote a different 1,024-question bank; it is not this set and does not override it. The lens embeds the D006 questions verbatim and returns adversarial_review_result records.

side_effects: runs sha256sum, ffprobe and ffmpeg on the artifact under review
writes extracted frames and contact sheets to a scratch directory

evidence_notes: Agent definition written for this catalogue from the guide's method and the area's questions; it has not been run on a film. Its questions are the owner's exact text.
